description: F-AM: phone = DM against a Node Host + Players; activation, secrets, change requests, per-target effects, reconnects, Host X -> Host Y

CHECK ok: before approval the joiner holds NO capability
CHECK ok: DM screen is not reachable before approval
CHECK ok: after approval the phone is DM only (not Host, not Player)
STEP: I-J: choose the prepared campaign; nothing prepared is live; Host cannot see DM material
CHECK ok: Bridge Ambush is NOT active after linking
CHECK ok: Blessing / Hidden Curse are NOT applied after linking
CHECK ok: Host state does not contain "automation fixture note"
CHECK ok: Host state does not contain "the troll"

CHECK ok: Host state does not contain "amulet is cursed"

CHECK ok: players never receive encounter DM notes
STEP: O-P: Blessing on multiple targets
CHECK ok: Blessing has one application per target
STEP: Q-R: Hidden Curse on Alice; inspect the serialized payloads Alice actually received
CHECK ok: Alice's raw wire bytes do not contain "Hidden Curse"
CHECK ok: Alice's persisted state does not contain "Hidden Curse"
CHECK ok: Alice's raw wire bytes do not contain "DMONLY"
CHECK ok: Alice's persisted state does not contain "DMONLY"

CHECK ok: Alice's persisted state does not contain "until remove curse"
CHECK ok: Bob learns nothing about the curse
CHECK ok: the curse still changes Alice's AC by -1 (mechanics intact, identity hidden)
STEP: S-V: Exhaustion Increase request; Alice modifies it to +2 and accepts
CHECK ok: Alice's character received the modified +2 exactly once
CHECK ok: the original +1 proposal is preserved
STEP: W-Z: Blessing due to end for Alice, end Alice only; Bob stays affected
CHECK ok: Due to End does not remove the effect
CHECK ok: Bob's Blessing is still ACTIVE
STEP: AA-AC: Alice disconnects; DM changes live state; Alice reconnects; no duplicates
CHECK ok: Alice's replica equals the Host's authorized projection after reconnect
CHECK ok: the request appears exactly once
CHECK ok: the secret curse appears exactly once
STEP: AD-AG: DM link is severed; the DM keeps preparing offline; reconnect keeps the newer preparation
CHECK ok: offline DM note never reached the Host
STEP: AH-AI: end the session; stop Host X
STEP: AJ-AM: a brand-new Host Y; the DM joins it and reuses the same campaign
CHECK ok: Host Y is a different session from Host X
CHECK ok: nothing from Host X followed the DM to Host Y
CHECK ok: Host Y carries no Host X identity
